description: This file contains setup and data population scripts for an educational management system, including functions to create masters, items, student applicants, groups, fee categories, fee structures, and assessment groups, primarily for initial data seeding.

methods.name: setup_data
methods.description: Main function to initialize educational setup data including masters, items, students, groups, fees, and assessments.

methods.name: make_masters
methods.description: Imports core master data such as Room, Department, Instructor, Course, Program, Student Batch Name, Assessment Criteria, and Grading Scale.

methods.name: setup_item
methods.description: Loads item data from JSON and creates Item documents with random minimum order quantities and default warehouse.

methods.name: make_student_applicants
methods.description: Generates student applicant records with random attributes and saves or submits them.

methods.name: make_student_group
methods.description: Creates student groups for each academic term and program based on course data.

methods.name: make_fees_category
methods.description: Creates various fee categories with descriptions.

methods.name: make_fees_structure
methods.description: Creates fee structures for each program and academic term with random fee components.

methods.name: make_assessment_groups
methods.description: Creates hierarchical assessment groups for each academic year and term.

methods.name: get_json_path
methods.description: Constructs the file path for JSON data files based on doctype.

methods.name: weighted_choice
methods.description: Selects an index based on weighted probabilities.
